Name: NpuVs

Description: Laboratory observation codes based on the NPU code system.

Name: LabSiteQualifierEuVs

Name: LabSpecialtyEuVs
Title: Laboratory Specialty
Description: Laboratory Specialties. Notes: Note 1: This value set is based on analysis of national coding practices in 8 European countries (AT, CZ, DE, FR, IE, IT, PT, SE) and agreed by involved lab experts as a common lab specialty value set. Note 2: Many European countries are using additional laboratory specialty types, which should be mapped towards this value set. Note 3: In case of documented need, this value set could be extended.

Name: LabSpeciesTypesEuVs
Title: Types of species
Description: Types of animal species for non-human subjects

Name: LabSpecimenAdditiveEu
Title: Specimen Additive
Description: List of the specimen additives. Additives are commonly added to the vacutainer tubes to preserve the specimen for laboratory analysis

Name: LabSpecimenContainerEu
Title: Specimen Container
Description: List of the containers commonly used to collect specimens (e.g. urine, blood,..).

Name: LabSpecimenTypesEuVs
Title: Specimen Types
Description: Laboratory Specimen Types

Name: LabStudyTypesEuVs
Title: Laboratory Study Types
Description: Laboratory Study Types Notes: Note 1:26436-6 (Laboratory studies) enables issuing a report putting together observations from multiple specialties (disciplines) in the same text block, allowing delivery of a global interpretation comment at the end of the text block that will be rendered at the end of the report. Note 2:Mycology and parasitology, as well as bacteriology, are part of the 18725-2 (Microbiology studies (set)) studies. Note 3:Virology MAY be included in 18725-2 (MICROBIOLOGY STUDIES) or 18727-8 (SEROLOGY STUDIES) or split between both study types, depending upon the Content Creator Actor’s choice.

Name: LabTechniqueEuVs
Title: Laboratory Techniques
Description: Laboratory technique (method of measurement) used for the result measurement (based on SNOMED CT).
